contentFull:
Kubota and Agtonomy introduce autonomous M5L tractor for specialty crops

 22-10 | Autonomous vehicles | News

LinkedInFacebookXWhatsAppPrint

Kubota North America and Agtonomy launched the autonomous Kubota M5L at FIRA USA as the next phase of their cooperation on autonomous tractors for specialty crops. Photos: René Koerhuis

Kubota North America and Agtonomy launch the next phase of their cooperation on autonomous tractors for specialty crops with the introduction of the autonomous Kubota M5L. 

Both strategic partners chose FIRA USA in Yakima (Washington State) as the launching ground for the autonomous Kubota M5L low profile tractor dedicated to North American growers of specialty crops and orchard and nut growers in particular. The model is the third model in line to be made autonomous by Agtonomy. It follows the Bobcat CT4045 compact tractor and the Kubota M5N low profile tractor.

The technology stack fitted to the new M5L is the same as that of the M5N, but you will find the components in different places to match the tractors’ designs and geometries, such as the sensor suite underneath the M5L rollbar.Same autonomy stack

While they are launching the M5L on their indoor booth, the M5N is being demonstrated with a trailed sprayer on the outdoor demo grounds at FIRA USA. Tim Bucher, CEO and co-founder of Agtonomy, explains to Future Farming that the technology his company fits to the tractors to make them autonomous is the same. “The technology itself and way of operating it is the same, but you will find the components in different places to match the tractors’ designs and geometries. This can particularly be seen in the sensor suites on top of the M5N ROPS rollbar and underneath the M5L rollbar.’ The distinction also appears in the stereo cameras fitted at the front of both tractor models.

The distinction also appears in the stereo cameras fitted at the front of both tractor models, with the front setup of the M5L pictured here.More capacity and use cases

While the M5N is tailored to narrow-row applications in particular, Kubota says the M5L brings a low-profile platform and increased lift capacity suited to the distinct needs of orchard and nut operations. It will allow growers to address a broader set of orchard applications, including spraying, sanitation mowing and underplant cultivation. Customers can rely on Kubota dealer support to help growers integrate the technology into their existing workflow.

The M5N is tailored to narrow-row applications in particular and has a Kubota V3800 engine delivering 106 horsepower. Its lifting capacity is 1,500 kilograms and it delivers up to 63 litres of oil per minute.The M5N-112 on demo at FIRA USA has a Kubota V3800 engine delivering 106 horsepower. Its transmission has 12 forward and 12 rearward speeds or 24 x 24 speeds in combination with the optional high/low. The lifting capacity is 1,500 kilograms and it delivers up to 63 litres of oil per minute. The M5L-111 also carries the Kubota V3800 engine delivering 114 horsepower. It has 32 forward and 32 rearward speeds or 48 x 48 speeds in combination with a creep option. It will lift 1,750 kilos as standard or 2,175 kilos with an optional assist cylinder. The maximum oil flow encompasses 67 litres per minute. North American growers interested in the new autonomous M5L can pre-order it for delivery in 2027.

translationZh:
久保田北美与Agtonomy在FIRA USA展会上推出自主版久保田M5L，标志着双方在特色作物自主拖拉机合作上进入下一阶段。

两家战略合作伙伴选择在华盛顿州亚基马举行的FIRA USA作为自主版久保田M5L低矮型拖拉机的发布地，该机型专为北美特色作物种植者设计，尤其面向果园和坚果种植者。这是Agtonomy实现自主化的第三款机型，此前分别为Bobcat CT4045紧凑型拖拉机和久保田M5N低矮型拖拉机。

新M5L搭载的技术栈与M5N相同，但组件位置不同以匹配拖拉机的设计和几何结构，例如传感器套件位于M5L防滚架下方。

**同一套自主技术栈**

虽然他们在室内展台发布M5L，但M5N正在FIRA USA室外演示场地进行牵引喷雾机演示。Agtonomy首席执行官兼联合创始人Tim Bucher向Future Farming解释，其公司为拖拉机加装以实现自主化的技术是相同的。“技术本身和操作方式相同，但组件位置不同以匹配拖拉机的设计和几何结构。这尤其体现在M5N ROPS防滚架顶部和M5L防滚架下方的传感器套件上。”两款拖拉机前部安装的立体相机也体现了这一区别。

**更大容量和更多应用场景**

Kubota表示，M5N特别针对窄行应用定制，而M5L则提供低矮平台和更大的提升能力，以适应果园和坚果作业的独特需求。它将使种植者能够应对更广泛的果园作业，包括喷洒、卫生割草和林下耕作。客户可依赖久保田经销商支持，帮助种植者将该技术整合到现有工作流程中。

M5N特别针对窄行应用定制，搭载久保田V3800发动机，输出106马力。其提升能力为1500公斤，油流量最高63升/分钟。在FIRA USA演示的M5N-112搭载久保田V3800发动机，输出106马力。其变速箱有12个前进挡和12个倒挡，或配合可选高低挡实现24×24挡。提升能力为1500公斤，油流量最高63升/分钟。M5L-111同样搭载久保田V3800发动机，输出114马力。它有32个前进挡和32个倒挡，或配合爬行选项实现48×48挡。标准提升能力为1750公斤，选装辅助油缸后可达2175公斤。最大油流量为67升/分钟。有兴趣的北美种植者可预购新的自主M5L，交付时间为2027年。
